Saving: open a score → you are in its working copy (autosave lives there; the file changes only on Save) · Save / CTRL+S when it's good · Name version when a chunk is done (freezes a copy, e.g. -v1.5) · Restore… makes a named version the file again (the file as it is now frozen first) · Reload if it went wrong (drops the unsaved edits) · a name starting piece- lives in the Piece menu, everything else in Experiments.
